subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Her _______________ attitude towards her colleagues made her a beloved team member.
solution:
The correct answer is '**cordial**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**cordial**" means warm and friendly. (मिलनसार या सौहार्दपूर्ण)
 
• Her cordial attitude towards her colleagues made her a beloved team member.
 
• The other options: "**indifferent**," "**apathetic**," and "**belligerent**" do not fit the context as they carry negative or unrelated meanings.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Her cordial__ attitude towards her colleagues made her a beloved team member.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Indifferent (उदासीन)**: means having no particular interest or sympathy.
 
• **Apathetic (उpathetic)**: means showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
 
• **Belligerent (लड़ाकू)**: means hostile and aggressive.
